title: Cornelia Arts Building

services.name: Guest Artist Exhibit Space
services.desc: We offer a premium front lobby space in our newly remodeled building, where artists can present work and sell directly to the public. If accepted, the artist pays a non-refundable fee of $250, but handles and keeps 100% of all their sales. Additional space may be available. The Cornelia Arts Building has been a place for local and international artists & artisans since 1986. services.name: Studio Rental
services.desc: Studio Dibs focuses on design simplicity- where the ideals of form and function complement each other to satisfy the need for a usable object. Lead by designer and artist, Clayton Dibble, who strives to be thoughtful and authentic with each project. For me, this allows the material and shape to take center stage. Whenever possible, Studio Dibs tries to work sustainably, with a continued awareness of its carbon footprint. My passion for art and design, along with collaboration efforts drive a curiosity and experimental side to my work. Drawing influences from the principal elements of Scandinavian design, functionality, simplicity, and craftsmanship remain at the forefront of my practice.
